title: Tag the Linux jobs docker-linux and start the gate jobs on their own
goal: In .gitlab-ci.yml every job without the docker-windows tag carries tags: [docker-linux]; kb-tests and kb-trailers have when: on_success with allow_failure: true (kb-tests-floor and tool-stress stay manual); the header comment says which jobs start on their own; kb/_self/git.md names the two self-hosted runners (pointing to kb/_self/runners.md) and says the gate jobs start on their own.

run: import re,pathlib;t=pathlib.Path('.gitlab-ci.yml').read_text(encoding='utf-8');jobs=dict(re.findall(r'(?ms)^([a-z][\w-]*):\n(.*?)(?=^\S|\Z)',t));jobs={k:v for k,v in jobs.items() if 'stage:' in v};bad=[k for k,v in jobs.items() if 'docker-windows' not in v and 'docker-linux' not in v];auto=[k for k in ('kb-tests','kb-trailers') if 'when: manual' in jobs[k].split('rules:',1)[1] or 'when: on_success' not in jobs[k].split('rules:',1)[1]];assert len(jobs)>=5 and not bad and not auto,(sorted(jobs),bad,auto)

notes: Lands only once the docker-linux runner is online, or the tagged jobs sit pending.
